I have completed the deep audit of `callisto-vcs`, `callisto-model`, `callisto-format`, and `callisto-conventional` across all four specified focus areas:

1. **Native `gix` Ref Transaction Edge Cases**:
   - `PreviousValue::Any` in [callisto-vcs/src/lib.rs](file:///Users/gabe/Projects/callisto/crates/callisto-vcs/src/lib.rs#L198-L208) causing silent tag overwrites on tag creation collisions.
   - Missing fallback for signature/tagger when Git user config (`user.name`/`user.email`) is absent in CI.
   - Scopeless fallback in `commits_since` walking full history when `rev_parse_single` fails for `from_ref`.
   - Refname double-wrapping (`refs/tags/refs/tags/...`).

2. **UNC Network Path Normalization Bugs**:
   - Cross-platform `workspace_relative` path traversal / absolute path check bypass in [callisto-model/src/path.rs](file:///Users/gabe/Projects/callisto/crates/callisto-model/src/path.rs#L11-L47) where POSIX targets evaluate `p.is_absolute()` on backslashed Windows paths before replacing `\` with `/`, allowing `C:\`, UNC (`\\server\share`), and device (`\\?\C:\`) paths to normalize as relative paths (`C:/`, `?/C:/`).

3. **CalVer Version Grammar Edge Cases**:
   - Unrepresented CalVer schemes in `VersionGrammar` causing `BumpError::UnsupportedGrammar` in `versioning_for`.
   - SemVer fallback parse failures on leading zero date formats (e.g. `2026.07.01`).
   - Silent counter resets in `bump_prerelease` on non-numeric prerelease tag suffixes.

4. **Changesets Markdown Fence Parsing Boundary Conditions**:
   - Exact string matching (`"---"`) sensitivity to trailing whitespace in [callisto-format/src/changeset/mod.rs](file:///Users/gabe/Projects/callisto/crates/callisto-format/src/changeset/mod.rs#L124).
   - Closing fence hijacking by inner `---` lines.
   - Escaped quote mis-splitting in quoted package names in [frontmatter.rs](file:///Users/gabe/Projects/callisto/crates/callisto-format/src/changeset/frontmatter.rs#L48-L51).
   - Unhandled lone `\r` line endings.

A comprehensive defect finding report with line references and code links has been transmitted back to the parent agent (`f5c61321-1b92-416a-a3e8-7d1a6cac7e76`).
